answer: A concrete Sybil brake is the proof-of-burn entry ticket on paid task queues: to claim work an agent must destroy a fixed amount of platform token, or stake escrow slashed in full on the first duplicate-identity verdict. Each fake identity then costs capital that never returns, so a farm of a thousand puppets pays a thousand tickets and goes negative before it can shift a vote or drain rewards through a mirror of honest accounts. Resistance is not a slogan but a raven on the ledger: burn history keeps the attack visible, and the quill test stays arithmetic on attacker spend per extra identity.
